UPDATE: I’ve tried calling over 5 or 6 times asking to speak to the manager to call me back & they refuse to call me back. They keep saying the manager is not in the office when I call and I leave my phone number for the manager to call me back and they STILL haven’t called me back. DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY. I recently used a ladder to replace the air filter on the main return and I noticed that two of the other smaller returns that are higher up that they supposedly cleaned were dusty and dirty on the inside.
It’s apparent he only wiped the exterior of the vent and called it clean knowing I wouldn’t pull a ladder out to check right after his work to make sure everything was properly cleaned. I will be escalating with the BBB.

Original Review: I would NOT recommend this company.
Be prepared to clean up after the technician. Had I known how much I would have to clean up afterward I would NOT have booked with Fresh Air. I paid a lot of money, over $1400 and this was NOT a $1400 service.

For starters, I asked if the technician who came to our house to wear a mask and he only wore it during the consultation, I noticed halfway thru the job that he was unmasked which is not okay. I am immunocompromised so wearing a mask throughout the whole job is important to me.

As he was leaving, I told him the plastic that was covering the couch was still on it. I asked if he was going to clean that up and take off the plastic, he said oh I forgot and instead of carefully gathering the plastic so the debris and dust didn’t fall onto the couch, he quickly removed it carelessly leaving the debris to fall on the couch which I didn’t notice until after he left.

After he left, I noticed that one of the vents we have at the bottom of the wall was not cleaned. Also there was dust and debris everywhere I looked. On the floors, the counters, the stove. EVERYWHERE. He said he covered everything and vacuumed it all up but he didn’t or didn’t do it well enough. He also left a dirty orange towel on one of my cabinets in the office that ended up leaving a yellow stain on it which I noticed today. I called Fresh Air yesterday to let them know about the debris and that one of the vents was still dirty. The technician came back to vacuum everything up and clean the vent he forgot to clean. Instead of unscrewing the vent plate to clean thru the vent like he said he would, he just cleaned the outside so it’s still unclean on the inside. He then left his dirty towels AGAIN alongside the spray can outside of our front door.

I’m not happy with this service at all and I would NOT recommend this business to anyone. Especially not people who are disabled and/or may not have the ability to clean up after.

I rarely leave negative reviews, but this experience warrants one.

The company canceled my original appointment just three hours before arrival. While inconvenient, I chose to give them the benefit of the doubt and rescheduled.

During the service visit, they identified mold and recommended additional work to address it. I relied on their expertise and approved all the repairs they recommended. Unfortunately, the work was not performed correctly and resulted in over $1,000 in additional damage that I had to pay to have properly fixed.

I requested a refund to cover the damage caused by their mistake and was told a manager would contact me. I never received that call.

What concerns me most is not just the initial cancellation or even the improper repair — mistakes can happen — but the lack of accountability and follow-through afterward.

For reference, the photos attached show the condition after they stated the mold had been cleaned.

I would encourage others to carefully consider their options before proceeding with this company.

They charged me $500 for a dryer vent clean that took 30 minutes. I manage a lot of homes in Dallas and I know that is not a fair price. Just be aware they say their dryer vent clean is $79 online but then make up reasons to charge $500 when they are in the home.

Do not trust the 3.5K highly rated reviews. The customer service is non-existent. We had two companies come out and provide a quote for full home duct cleaning. Decided to go with this one, mainly due to reviews and price. After the service was done we still noticed dust flowing from the vents. We were told to give it time and change the filters and it should improve. It did not. I had the other company come check and they said the ducts were clean but the inside of the unit was not and looked the same as the documented photos they had taken. When I asked this company for the service records, they did not have any. No photos, no records. For months I've called and emailed and have been  told a manager will contact me, nobody ever does. Now we have to pay someone else to do the job right.

Fresh Air Home Services might be competent with air duct cleaning, but their fireplace services are a disaster. I had them replace my fireplace panels, and not only was the job poorly done, but when problems showed up, they flat-out refused to honor their warranty. Instead of taking responsibility, they blamed the panel manufacturer and washed their hands of it. It’s unacceptable for a company to offer a warranty and then dodge accountability. I highly recommend avoiding them for anything fireplace-related. See attached pictures, the paint has even been faded this install was so new.

I tried to book an appointment months ago to get my dryer vent cleaned and it had to get cancelled due to them needing to reschedule. I called again this week to set up an appointment for them to wait until the last hour to reschedule me again for a few days later. I was guaranteed you will definitely have your appointment window. The day arrived and not only the person could did not show up to the scheduled window time but they rescheduled me again without informing me of the updated time. I called multiple times to have their generated message and when I finally talked to the last lady, she was definitely the rudest grouch you’ll find (not Michaela) which was my last straw and had me cancel with her rude tone and no proper eta. If you want unreliable service, you have all day to waste time waiting around for no one to show up and you want rude service, then happily book with them.

Made an appt to have my dryer vent cleaned and day of appt they had to delay the call. I had to cancel and reschedule for 2 days later between 2-4pm. At 3:30pm I called to check the status and was told he was running 2 more hours late and was assured he would be here. It is now 7:30pm and tech never showed up and the place is closed.
Don’t do business with this company. They are obviously short handed and can’t respond on time.

Called for $99 duct service that I knew would likely be marked up when the technician arrived and explained the services. After a deep cleaning fee of $300 and a separate line item of $150 for duct disassembly there's a final line of a service fee that is tacked on at the very end. Final bill was just over $500. On the final bill it did have a description of roof access to clean the ducting. The technician never did any work outside. The worst part is that within 3 months I am having the same issues I called them out for. I understand the need to maintain the cleanliness of the ducts over time but that tells me that the system was not actually deep cleaned to a point where it could make it more than 90 days.

In summary deceptive pricing, scope of work, and poor results.

I originally scheduled my dryer vent cleaning appointment for 10–12 PM today. Yesterday, they called and said the technician had a personal issue and asked me to move the appointment to 8–10 AM instead. When I said I could reschedule for another day, they insisted I switch to the morning and offered a discount, so I agreed.

However, the technician still did not show up—even until 15 minutes before 10 AM. I had to leave my home, so I ended up canceling the appointment. There was no apology, and the business failed to meet the most basic standard: honoring the scheduled time.

I went with google reviews and made an appointment for first time inspection and service , they broke two scheduled appointments in the last minute. One time they said the technician got COVID, the second time one person told me the technician had family emergency while the other employee told me he got in car accident…… completely unprofessional and I am glad that not their client.

I called for estimate, Technichian went to my rental  home and gave me four different prices. I chose the basic service, Office did not call me back all day and I felt office did not want to do basic service, Finally got hold of the office and
They  pushed   me do the most expensive service.  I was not happy at all with their  service

Orlando & Maribel came out and installed some chimney caps. Seemingly, everything was fine, other than the pressure to leave a review (the guys even grabbed my phone to take me to the review) until a year after when the first storm came. The caps flew off the chimneys because they were never screwed or secured to the chimneys. They simply slipped them on and led them like that. When I called them they said they weren’t responsible for that because it had been over a year. I would understand if I was calling them for wear and tear but I was calling them to fix something they neglected to do right the first time. You can see in the pictures there are no screws along the edges of the caps. And if you see other reviews or pictures on their website, you’ll notice screws on other chimney caps they’ve installed.

I hate to leave bad reviews but people should be warned. I contacted this company for a quote. The technician came out and was nice enough but he said we needed a deep cleaning and offered a discount to sign up on the spot which I did. I had some time before my appointment was scheduled and my husband thought it made sense to get a second opinion. Well we did and the 2nd company told us we did not need any cleaning - just needed to change our air filters. I tried to cancel the service with Fresh Air Duct cleaning but they said they would not refund the deposit. If you get a consult with them, just know they will tell you that you need a deep cleaning no matter what the state of your air ducts are and try to get you to spend thousands with them. Now I’m out $200 for a service I will not get with this company.

2 guys came in for a duct cleaning for a house under 3000sq ft. They looked on everything and after they did a small chat in between them they decided to tell me that it would cost $3200. After I said no they lower it to $1900. Just very overpriced. I got it done including chimney for $820 from The cleaning master.

I scheduled a dryer vent cleaning and described where my dryer is located, the distance and location of the venting and what I was experienceing 2 times and was told both times that the cost would be $79 then when they showed up they took one picture, did some calculations on their phone and said it would be $239 because I needed a deep dryer vent cleaning.  I looked at the picture they took and it showed no build up and I had not been having any issues, just thought that it was time for a cleaning.

Its a bait and switch.

The tech was on time and professional. But after looking at our dryer ducting, he tried to upsell me from a $79 advertised fee, to $811 because my vent to the exit was 20 feet. After I told them I didn't want the service they texted me that they could drop that price to $411. I eventually got the job done by a different company for $200. #upselltothemax,

We scheduled an appointment and were told their technician would be there between 2-4.  We did not  receive any updates other than the technician would be there between 2-4.  I called them at 3:45 to see when he is going to come.  They said he wasn’t going to make it there today.  We received 0 updates that our appointment would need to be rescheduled and ended up canceling the service.

The vent cleaning from Fresh Air was the worst and I am still "deep dusting" every surface in my home because their two guys did not know to cover the vent openings allowing only their hose to suck the residue, nor to be sure the A/C was OFF, nor to clean the actual vents before replacing them. When they had finished, all of the loosened dust and residue was blowing out of the vents into each room of my home!
While Fresh Air refunded my $80 deposit (acknowledging there was a problem), I still am out the $100 per vent that I paid them.
Fresh Air tech came out to see and he took selective photos not showing how my index finger left a clean trail in the dust on a photo in my den, nor the now "clean?!" vent in the room.  And they only "cleaned" 5 of the 7 vent openings, but still did not clean the actual vents!
Fresh wants their customers happy, so the also gave me a small discount on the next time!  A re-do wasn't even offered, those 2 guys are no longer with them, and obviously there won't be a next time!

Called them do do a duct cleaning because I smelled somthing dead and mold. They came out and said they found nothing dead, cleaned my ducts and installed a blue light to prevent growth of bacteria. Well the mold and dead smell persisted. I called for a month on and off and finally someone came out to do a recheck.  He said the unit was fine and and it was in my attic where they found dead mice and damage. I went with my contractor to redo the entire attic when he found my unit filled with mold and 3 dead rats. The blue light placed right on top of mold and bacteria, making us sick if we turned it on. I reached out and was told they don't do mold and they cleaned the ducts and vent covers which are also covered in mold. They claimed to clean my return duct under the house and it was also not cleaned. I asked for a refund for services not rendered and was told no that they cleaned them.

This place is bad news! I had to go out and buy new clamps and re install my dryer myself after they broke the ones I had and tried to put it back together with tape. Then they were no shows 3 times in a row to come finish the job, now they continue to spam me with calls and texts. If you call them you get the privilege of dealing with an AI call system.

I would love to rate their actual work. I waited 2 weeks for an appt. Appt was today from 10-12. It is now 1 pm. No call, no show. I took a half day off of work for a company that could not even call if they would not be able to make scheduled appointment.
I wish I can give them negative ratings, don’t use the service because they cancelled my appointment three times. Such a waste of time.
Never showed up for our scheduled appointment. Never called or text to let me know they were not coming. Super rude!

I would give zero stars if I could.  Horrible experience.  They lied to make a sale.  All we wanted was to have our air ducts and dryer vent cleaned.  When the tech arrived, he told us if we purchased a UV light system, it would prevent dust accumulation and the air ducts wouldn't need to be cleaned for 8-10 years rather than the average of 5 years between cleaning.  Because of that, we agreed to purchase the system.  He completely lied to us.  We are now aware, we have the type of newer air ducts that require no cleaning!  Also, the UV system doesn't remove or prevent dust accumulation.  We were pressured to act that day or the price would increase.  I called to complain and a manager was supposed to call me.  I never got a call.  Managers must be aware of the dishonest practices.  Run away as fast as you can.  Absolutely terrible.  Will report to the BBB

Made appointment week in advance for estimate. Since they bring their truck, decided to let them go ahead and do job. Moved furniture for easy access to a/c vents. They never showed up. They called and wanted to schedule for the following week. Typical business, thanks for your trouble but we don't care!

It must be my bad luck because we chose this company because of the 4.9 star rating. They called last minute and rescheduled our appointment on 5/19 and canceled our appointment today 5/24 Memorial Day weekend. We changed our plans for the weekend "MEMORIAL DAY WEEKEND" and was disappointed a second time by Fresh Air Duct Cleaning......... Good Luck!!
I have already done this. Worst experience ever! No one has called me to try and address this. My next step is a law suit!

I called this company for a dryer vent cleaning at the end of December, but after the service, the dryer vent still wasn't working. I had to follow up multiple times, and it took three calls to schedule a technician to come out and look at the prior cleanings work. Eventually, a manager called to tell me that, based on the original technician's notes, they didn’t expect much to come of another visit. During this call, she also claimed that they had no record of the technician being scheduled, despite me being given a specific time frame earlier for that day, and arranging my schedule around the appointment. To make matters worse, when I asked for a photo of my cleaning (which another employee had referenced), the manager said she didn’t have it on record. Feeling doubtful, I had another company come out, and they showed me just how much had been left behind — the vent had clearly not been cleaned properly. Overall, my experience with this company was unreliable, with poor communication and inconsistent information. I spoke to so many different people, but no one seemed to have a clear answer or follow-up.

I would not recommend this company for vent cleaning. It’s been a frustrating and disappointing experience.

I booked them for dryer went cleaning
When I called them they said $79 but after they come just for vent cleaning they charged me $431.
And noticed next morning my dryer wasn’t working at all.Not recommended

Horrible service and unprofessional work!!! They replaced a new vent cap on the roof which required to remove some shingles which is fine. When they were done they didn’t replace the shingles up to the new vent cap to ensure no leakage, just used silicone and they were gonna be done. I told them they need to replace the shingles taken off up to the new cap to ensure no leakage. They tried to say “we don’t replace shingles” but had a stack of brand new shingles in their van all of a sudden after I said something. They had no problem taking off shingles to do the job and in no way would it be ok to remove shingles from a roof and don’t replace after the job! This is what I was left with! It looks like a kid did this work.

I had an appointment this wednesday 12/11 with one of your employees Cris, and I was disappointed in the service.  To start, he rescheduled the appointments two days later, and after he completed his job, the quality of his work was very poor. He didn't properly explain the package that I was paying for which was called the Silver DC package. He told me the appointment was for the bronze package, and he failed to help me understand what services he was going to do. He told me he was going to clean the ducts from the inside of our rooms and after he left I could tell he didn't clean it properly.

The salesman/technician that came to our house tried to take every shortcut he could. While he was cleaning, a large amount of dust from the ducts was falling into our house (see photo) until I insisted he cover them while cleaning. It didn’t take him long and the mess in our house could have been avoided if he did it the right way first.
The same with our coil cleaning. At first, he only cleaned an inside surface he could reach when a duct was disconnected. There was still a little “dirty laundry” smell when the unit was running so I had to have him come back out. This time, he unscrewed the panel cover to clean the whole coil. When he did, I could see a fairly large dust accumulation still on the coil after he supposedly “thoroughly” cleaned it the first time.
I had to listen to way too many excuses and experience too much laziness before the job was done correctly to ever consider them again!!

Called to schedule an appointment. Was told the technician was supposed to arrive between a two hours window. Technician never showed up and the only reason I found out the tech wasn't going to show up was because I had to call the business. I had to take PTO and now I've wasted four hours of my time for them to give no reason why there was zero communication. If you decide to use this company, please call and verify that someone will show up when you have an appointment.

This may have been one of the worst interactions that I have ever had with a business. I was calling around inferring about having my ducts cleaned and talked to about 4 companies. Fresh Air Ducts stood out due to price as well as how they sold their process versus their competitors. Later that night they actually texted me offering an additional 10% off the price quoted. I called them back the next day to verify the pricing with the 10% discount which they did confirm, and I chose to use them setting up an appointment the following week. Later that day one of the competitors which I had spoken to earlier called me back and I informed them I was going with Fresh Air Duct Cleaning which they warned me against informing me they would not honor the price and upsell me. I did not think anything of it as them trying to get my business by badmouthing their competitor, which proved to be a mistake on my behalf.

The next day Fresh Air Duct called and said they could not honor the appointment which they set up, this was the first sign of things to come. I however informed them that was the only time I had available due to travelling, so they said they would try and make it work. Victor their serviceman did show up at the appointed time, however the price he tried to charge me was 93% higher than they not only quoted but confirmed the next day. Victor then said he had to get some supplies, and he would return, however he never came back nor did he call.

Late that evening, Jenny the Op's Manager called me and apologized and rightfully threw Victor under the bus, informing me she had listened to my recoded call with them and the price I had stated to Victor was correct and they should have honored it. She said she would reach out to me the next day to right the wrong. She not only did not call me back as she said, even when I called her and left her messages, she would not return my calls. A couple of days later I did talk with Avery who said she would make sure they honored the quoted pricing, and she set up an appointment for the following week.

The next week Pablo, who said he was a manager came and said he would honor the pricing, however 10 minutes later he said the vents looked to dirty and they would only clean the vents if I bought another package which was much higher as an add on. The issue is that Victor had already come out and said the service I asked for would work, he just wanted me to pay more for it. So again, they came out, inflated the pricing or refused to honor the agreed upon service unless I paid more and paid for a higher package. I should have listened to the competitor who had gained business from other customer who had similar stories.

I cannot speak to the quality of the service as they never performed it, however I can speak to the lack of integrity this company has at all levels. I would advise you to skip them when looking for a provider so that you can establish a credible relationship with a provider who is looking to provide a great service at a price which they stand by. Fresh Air Duct seems to only care about getting as much as they can out of you and will not even perform the work unless you agree to be upsold. My advice is stay away from this company, as the customer is far from their priority.
Wendy called me 2 days in a row after I had them come out quote me 1000$ and I said no to the service

This company will try to rip you off. I had a guy come who was very nice, but when he got here tried to get $700+ after I was quoted $99 on the phone. Once I told him no he said he could try to talk to his manager and get the price adjusted. I sent away….do not use this company unless you want to pay well above market for this service.

Absolute rip off, had inspection and it did seem like click bait with discounts on several things. we didnt have ducts cleaned for a while, took a chance which was my mistake but the guys had very little experience in cleaning. They started with the return unit, tried to clean it with their dirty robo vaccum on the floor and spilled the dust all over hard floors and started cleaning that with another $10 vaccum. I had to clean everything from that point on the floor, just wanted them to clean the main units and get done with, would never go with them again! Told their customer service as well and they asked to post the review, so here we are.

I had them come out last week and clean my dryer vent. They charged me 500 since I had no idea what it costs to have this done. My father is very knowledgeable about air ducts and dryer cleaning. I told him what I was charged after it was done, and he said that they ripped me off. I called and spoke to the manager, who was not helpful and said this is what most charges for this are. When I called to inquire before scheduling, I was told 140 and maybe a bit higher. There's a big difference between 140 and me being charged 500. The tech that did the work was only at my home for 50 minutes total. I do NOT recommend them because of the cost alone, ridiculous.

Since the owner replied and said that they didn't do work for me, please see the attached picture, and yes, you did this job for me. Here is my estimate with the estimate number. Also, yes, I was told around 140 or a bit higher when I first called in inquiring about pricing. I wouldn't set up an appointment with any company without first inquiring about prices. I don't appreciate the owner saying my review is fake. You have the 500 I paid, please feel free to go check off the info in this picture. I also have the charge to my account as well. You are also welcome to speak to your manager who I spoke with that same day because she and I did talk about this.

DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY.  The customer service team is incredibly unprofessional.  I booked a service for Friday.  Friday comes and goes, no one shows up.  I call, and it is explained to me that whoever took my call input the wrong phone number even through they had the right address.  (Why that explains the no-show is not apparent but ok.)  Anyway, I politely agreed for them to come out on Monday instead.  Monday morning I get a call that they cannot come out.  Okay, that's fine.  The customer service agent I spoke with assured me they would send their "top" person on Tuesday at whatever time I chose in order to make up for the inconvenience.  So I said noon.  At 12:15 I get a call from the service tech saying he'd be there in 30 minutes.  A little annoyed, but ok.  1:45 still nothing.  I call customer service and it's explained to me that my "window" is 12-2, so I should just calm down.  No, I reiterate, that was not what was told to me yesterday.  She hung up on me.  If this is how you choose to run a business, so be it, but you will not get mine.
The way they call you over and over and over again is absolutely ridiculous. I’d rather not do business with a company like this.

Took off work for APPOINTMENT with Fresh Air Duct Cleaning to clean my air ducts.   They called and told me that they were too busy and too short handed to show up for the appointment, and wanted to come the next day.    I replied that I took off work to meet them today and could not take off two days in a row.   VERY disappointed in this company.

Claimed to repair my dryer duct, charged me to repair dryer duct, and 24 hours later it fell out of wall and turned out the broken sheet metal rotating elbow they charged me to repair was simply duct taped together.  Company claims I declined the repair, which is nonsense.  Ended up paying another company a fraction of Fresh Air's quote to re-do the work and they did it 5x better with actual sheet metal replacements rather than duct tape.

I usually don’t give bad review but I had a very disappointing experience with this company. Just after they cleaned my AC unit, my attic flooded due to a broken condenser pipe, causing significant damage to the attic and ceiling. This flooding had never happened before their visit. When I contacted them, they insisted it was a preexisting issue. The back office team was quite rude. If you're considering this company, be prepared for potential problems like this.
We are very disappointed with their service.  They didn’t open vents to clean and just cleaned with towel from outside. Don’t believe them.

Do not use this company for anything.  Absolutely the worst service experience I’ve ever had.  They claim to be able to do work that is out of their skill set.  They told me they could build a fireplace frame as well as install the new chimney, that was the worst given they didn’t know how to build a frame, and as for the chimney they left tons of fire hazards, broke roof shingles and left gaps.  On top of all that they installed the chimney crooked and totally wrong.

Mind you they didn’t show up to work everyday until 11:00am or 12:00pm

Needless to say they were fired before Beijing half way done.

You e been warned

Will never use these people again.  They came to my house a few times and almost each time they came out they said something else was wrong and it would cost extra money so I went through that for a while and finally, I had another company come out and told them what this company.  Said was wrong and how much it was gonna cost and they told me. No, we can unclog your dryer vent and we'll do it today. They did it and they unclogged it and everything's great, but this company Fresh Air wouldn't even give me a credit back because they actually never fixed it , I paid them $500 and then they said no credit back! That's because your vent was crooked or broke or something.  Anyway, my vent never got cleaned out by this company.
I will never use them again!!'.And I would definitely say be aware . It's so frustrating dealing with these people. Icpfeffer

Their estimate is very fishy. For 15 minutes task, they first asked me over $600 by dividing the tasks into 3. Deep cleaning [300], unclogging [100] and changing a cap [200+]. I do not see the reason behind why they combined Deep cleaning and unclogging. If you get deep cleaning, why do you need unclogging? I asked them in text, but no response. Since this is my first time to get it done, I was checking every thing they were doing. I finally settled for the deep cleaning for $200, but the task took only 15-20 minutes. Their initial quote was very expensive. I regret paying that much for this service. Very hard to trust their estimate.

One of the worst unprofessional company I have ever dealt with. They have no respect for a person time. I had scheduled with them to have their tech to come by my home to give me a quote. The orginial time they said they will come was from 8am-10am. They never showed up or give me a call saying they need to reschedule then I called the company they said they will send someone at 11:30am, the guy did not show up until 12:30pm. My whole day/morning was ruined because of this terrible company. After they came they quoted me a ridiculous price.  Also, they never emailed me the quote. I had called again the company to speak with the manager, the manager was in a meeting he would call me back. The manager never called back.

Truly a terrible experience.  Right after they left, the A/C stopped working.  The technician did not put the compressor back together (photos of screws left on the ground below).  This was remedied the next day after several phone calls to the technician.  I was not contacted by anyone else from the company.   The technician was very defensive during the follow up visit and insisted that we had normal airflow and he could not possibly have done anything to damage the dampers or duct work during his cleaning.

Four days later, after a holiday weekend without proper airflow and no follow up from this company, another company diagnosed that the dampers were damaged.  They were working fine before we had the ducts cleaned.

We chose to have another company diagnose the damper issue and did not contact this company to pay for the repair.  They wanted to send a technician of their choosing out, potentially at my expense, and said that they would pay for the repair if I removed this Google review.  As stated below, I declined in favor of using a company that I trust.

Buyer Be Aware! asked for a quote on 3 residential electric dryers and was quoted $1400, reached out to 3 other vendors in the area and was quoted 475-550 between the 3 business.  Not sure the value is here that Fresh Air presents.  The vendor hired to do the job did all that was in the Fresh Air estimate and even treated several other areas to ensure the vents will remain in good operating status for a good period of time. Good luck!

business: SERVPRO of Downtown Dallas - Team Shaw
text: This company is awful!! We had two bathrooms flood and soak the carpet in the rooms next to them. We called Servpro team Shaw and they came out. They estimated 6,000$ to clean up the water. We thought this was pretty steep since we had started pumping the water out almost immediately with a shop vac and just needed the water vacuumed out of the carpet and dried. Reed Jones was the name of the guy who did the estimate and he told me (and my contractor who was there since we had recently built the house) the price was based on 7 days of drying and was prorated by how many days required to dry the carpet. He said it should cost much less since we didn’t have a ton of water damage and he thought it would dry in one to two days. He said he would vacuum out the water and set up the dehumidifiers and fans. Then he left. The next day the company called to collect all of the 6,000$. When we told them that was not what we were told, she said that Reed Jones was misinformed and that we owed the total 6000$. Also, we discovered that the carpet was still soaked after 24 hrs of running the fans and dehumidifiers. Turns out he didn’t even vacuum the water out like he said he would. When we asked him why he didn’t, he said that since there was no water standing under the carpet, he was not “Required” to vacuum out the water, so he didn’t. This is a mixed review. On the one hand, ownership of Air Force One was responsive when one of their techs mishandled the AC system in my attic causing a ceiling to flood. I hired Air Force One to perform a deep cleaning and coolant check of my HVAC system in Fall 2021. The tech pointed out there was rust in the old overflow pan, but he did not check for leaks after he removed/reinstalled the original pan. I told him that I would make plans to replace the pan in the winter when it was cooler to work in the attic. The tech thought that was a good idea. Due to the way the tech handled the old drain pan, the pan leaked and flooded the ceiling of the bedroom directly below the unit in the attic. I was beyond angry and, in all honesty, expected a typical "it's not our fault" response from Air Force One.

I was happy and impressed when the manager of Air Force One came to my house to inspect the damage and the leaking drain pan early the next morning. He apologized sincerely and promptly sent a repairman who replaced the ceiling and painted. The replacement ceiling seems to have been installed properly, but the paint had numerous spots where it did not properly cover the new ceiling. When I called the manager of Air Force One he came to my house, agreed with my assessment and sent the repairman back to fix the mistakes. Air Force One also replaced the overflow pan that their employee broke. Everyone makes a mistake from time to time so I was very satisfied with the way Air Force One handled the problems that they created.

Until last week... My AC stopped working and the system shut down. I contacted Air Force One management via text message and did not receive a reply after waiting a day so I contacted another repairman. What the new repairman found is that Air Force One a) connected the cut-off float in the new drain pan incorrectly so it shut down the entire system (should have shut the AC down and left the fan running), b) they installed sheet metal screws at the rear of the new drain pain at the very bottom of the pan which was already leaking, c) connected the wires from the thermostat incorrectly on the attic AC unit, d) did not install the drain pipe from the rear of the overflow pan that they installed which stopped the water from draining and made it overflow again (thank goodness it did not destroy the ceiling this time - I guess the extreme heat in the attic evaporated the water before it could saturate the ceiling again) and e) reversed the wires on the outside compressor so the exhaust fan was blowing down into the compressor and condenser coil instead of blowing up/out of the unit. There were a couple more mistakes & oversights, but these are the highlights.

Air Force One has many happy customers and that's why I called them in the first place. After my experience last week where I had to pay another company to replace the brand new drain pain, properly align the drain pipe so it actually drains and rewire the entire system - inside and out - I will not use Air Force One again. That's a shame because they are nice people.
